rules.rationale: Source ESOL long SMILES cut solubility (-11.46); if solubility and partition anti-correlate, long lipophilic chains favor octanol.
Source prior: short SMILES raised solubility (+6.89); compact polar molecules hydrate well and partition poorly.
Ring role carried the strongest transfer weight (0.758); fused carbocycles add hydrophobic surface that penalizes aqueous solubility.
Donor-count role transferred to heteroatom bin (weight 0.509); polar heteroatoms raise hydration and depress logD.

skills.hypothesis: Transfers ESOL size, ring and donor effects with reversed sign under the solubility-partition antipode. Fails if lipophilicity is driven by polarity balance rather than molecular size.

rules.rationale: Moderate halogen load adds polarizable, poorly hydrated surface without excessive molecular weight; raises octanol affinity.
Low heteroatom count means carbon-rich scaffolds with minimal hydration shell, the direct driver of high partition coefficients.
Halogen-free molecules often carry polar functionality instead; absence of lipophilic halogen surface weakens octanol partitioning.
Non-aromatic scaffolds lack extended nonpolar pi surface and often bear hydrophilic groups, lowering the partition score.

skills.hypothesis: Mechanistic partition model: halogen polarizability and hydrocarbon-rich composition raise lipophilicity, while halogen-free and non-aromatic scaffolds partition poorly. Fails if size or ionization dominates composition in this pool.

lesson: Solubility-based transfer needs an unverified sign flip and rests on low-confidence length evidence, so composition descriptors that map directly onto octanol-water partitioning should carry deployment.
revision_summary: Rewrote both skills with single field-value condition maps and at most four rules. Kept the antipode skill but lowered confidence to 0.42 and trimmed its weight on the weak length relation; broadened the domain skill by replacing the narrow halogen_high (98 candidates) rule with halogen_mid gain and halogen_none penalty plus an aromatic_none hydrophilicity rule, and deployed the domain skill.
